title: Radon transform for $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$
summary: In this paper, we study the Radon transform associated with the unipotent radical subgroups of $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_q)$. We analyze properties of the Radon transform with a specific emphasis on its eigenvalues. We provide a description of its eigenvalues for the cases of $GL_2(\mathbb{F}_q)$ and $GL_3(\mathbb{F}_q)$.
